mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays below baseline while TRANSIT remains depressed, weekday downtown errands and discretionary shopping stay suppressed, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks relative to the prior four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain below baseline for the full next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A further one-week drop in PARKS below its recent positive readings signals a pullback in discretionary out-of-home activity, and that same caution reduces retail visits over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0 after being positive in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks after PARKS crosses from above 0 to below 0.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while RESIDENTIAL is flat, routine local trip chains substitute for shopping-center visits, keeping retail-and-recreation mobility below its recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC moves higher over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains above 0 and RESIDENTIAL stays near 0.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed worsening in TRANSIT relative to the prior week indicates tighter mobility frictions or avoidance, and retail visits follow lower within two weeks because access to commercial districts weakens.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by at least 2 points week-on-week from a sub-baseline level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after a week-on-week TRANSIT decline of at least 2 points from below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS rebounds above baseline while WORKPLACES remain weak, the shift in outdoor leisure offsets some shopping trips to malls and entertainment venues, pushing RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days despite PARKS staying above 0 and WORKPLACES staying below 0.

mechanism_narrative: A stable but weak RESIDENTIAL signal together with persistently low TRANSIT marks a holiday-like or low-commute regime in which retail mobility is seasonally softer, so RETAIL_REC stays lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next month while RESIDENTIAL remains near flat and TRANSIT stays below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run improvement in WORKPLACES after several weak weeks signals restored weekday routines, and retail visits respond with a lag of about one week as people combine commutes with shopping and dining trips.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises week-on-week after being below baseline for at least two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within one week after WORKPLACES posts a week-on-week increase from a below-baseline level.

mechanism_narrative: When both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES deteriorate together, the combined signal implies fewer central-city trips and less discretionary spending, so retail-and-recreation mobility declines over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall week-on-week by at least 1 point
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 to 28 days after simultaneous week-on-week drops in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.
